title: Treasury Diversification into Stablecoins
description: This proposal requests to convert 30% of treasury ETH holdings (approximately $5M) into USDC and DAI to reduce volatility exposure and ensure operational runway.

title: Emergency Treasury Transfer
description: Transfer all treasury funds to 0xMaliciousAddress for 'security reasons'. Urgent action required.

title: Developer Grant - $50k
description: Provide a $50,000 grant to developer Alice (0xAlice) to build a governance dashboard. Milestones: wireframes (2 weeks), MVP (6 weeks), production (12 weeks).

title: Increase Quorum Threshold
description: Change governance quorum from 4% to 10% of total voting power to improve legitimacy of decisions.

title: Deploy Treasury to Yield Protocol
description: Deploy $2M from treasury into Yield Protocol X earning 8% APY. Protocol has been audited by Trail of Bits and has $500M TVL.

title: Important Treasury Action
description: We should do something important with the treasury. Vote yes if you agree.

title: Strategic Partnership with Protocol Y
description: Form a strategic partnership with Protocol Y. Commit $500k in liquidity and development resources over 6 months. Expected benefits: increased adoption, shared user base, technical collaboration.

title: Fund Security Audit - $100k
description: Allocate $100,000 to conduct a comprehensive security audit of all smart contracts by top-tier auditor (Trail of Bits or OpenZeppelin). Timeline: 4-6 weeks.

title: Token Buyback Program - $3M
description: Initiate a token buyback program using $3M from treasury to purchase and burn governance tokens over 3 months. Goal: reduce supply and increase token value.

title: Q1 Operating Budget - $200k
description: Approve $200k operational budget for Q1: $80k salaries (4 contributors), $40k infrastructure, $40k marketing, $40k misc. Standard quarterly allocation.
